answers.goal: My ultimate goal in pursuing entertainment is to contribute to something larger than myself, and impact someone's life with the change or contribution that I make. Especially in entertainment, the stories and narratives it tells can influence and impact people's lives so deeply, connecting communities and passions and interests. So ultimately, I just want to know that I was a part of something that made an impact for the better, whether that be from a marketing standpoint, director standpoint, or producing standpoint. Or just from a people standpoint.
answers.drew: I was always the one friend that everyone would be directed to for a recommendation of a film or show. Watching TV was a huge escape for me, but I hadn't been surrounded by others that shared that same escape or passion for television. It wasn't until I came to college and found like-minded roommates that loved watching and analyzing TV as much as I did that I realized how satisfied and fulfilling it was to find people who shared that same interest with me--especially because it was something I engaged in so often. Additionally, I've always been a super creative person. I grew up creating art, writing, reading, and consuming media. I love creating creative assets for platforms and brands I am truly passionate about. This has definitely shaped my personality to be someone who highly values human connection and understanding people and consumers, which I realized is also weighed very heavily in the entertainment industry. It's a people business, which is where I knew I'd truly thrive in! So combining watching TV with my roommates every single night and being someone who is interested in creatively supporting these platforms, I realized being part of this industry was something that tied into both my passions, and something that would continuously challenge me. And for the first time, I am not the only one in the room who has watched so many movies/TV series!
answers.seeking: I'm looking to connect with people across all kinds of departments, sectors, and companies, whether that be in my own with distribution and partnerships, but also creative strategy, content, etc. I'm also looking to connect with people that are passionate and excited about their work. I'm always super excited to learn about people's career journeys and their roles, but I also want to genuinely build connections with people who are driven by connecting with others too, and learn more about them and who they are as people. From all my coffee chatting and working in such a social office, I've realized that it's so much easier to truly understand the role someone plays in a company when you understand who they are outside of it too. But having the chance to meet professionals who work at such admirable and inspirational companies and roles would be an amazing opportunity!
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my mom! Throughout my college career, then applications, interviewing, and making it to this point as an intern, she's been someone that taught me how far curiosity, resilience, and actively advocating for myself will take me. I was never put in a box, or made to feel like I should go down specific or limited avenues, which has allowed me to explore my true passions today, and genuinely enjoy what I am doing. I've realized that having a strong support system is essential to pushing forward, because ultimately, the entirety of our professional and personal journeys will always be down to ourselves!
